title: Đấu Sĩ La Mã Phút Cuối (10s)
brief: A Roman Gladiator's Last-Second Reaction — 10s 9:16 code-animated B6 smoke film
premise: A young Roman gladiator enters the Colosseum, nearly gets caught by a stray falling spear, and snaps his bronze shield up in the nick of time.
hook: One stray spear. One split-second reaction.
